with its certificate, so the server creates its queue and agents get its public key.<br>• Give Bürokratt A the Global-Classifier agent ID (for example in <i>constants.ini</i>).<br>• Agree the message contract first: the new message types and the <i>inReplyTo</i> field are shared by DMR, the Global-Classifier and every installation." Configuration, not code
• DMR server reads the agent list from CentOps integration/clients every 30 minutes. Exists.
• Deploy the Global-Classifier's DMR agent and register it in CentOps as a client with its certificate, so the server creates its queue and agents get its public key.
• Give Bürokratt A the Global-Classifier agent ID (for example in constants.ini).
• Agree the message contract first: the new message types and the inReplyTo field are shared by DMR, the Global-Classifier and every installation.
